---
title: "Agency Express Transactions"
output: html_document
date: "2024-10-22"
---

```{r}
#Loading packages
pacman::p_load(readxl,tidyverse,lubridate,janitor)
```

```{r}
#Import Agency Express Data
ae_documentline <- read_excel("AE Data.xlsx", sheet = "AE - DocumentLine", col_types = "text")
```

```{r}
# Data Cleaning
ae_documentline <- ae_documentline|>
  clean_names()|>
  mutate(accepteddate = ymd(accepteddate))|>
  rename(accepted_date = accepteddate)|>
  filter(!is.na(accepted_date))
```

```{r}
#Import Data on Georgia Natural Disasters
events_GA <- read_csv("events-GA-2014-2024.csv", skip = 2)
```

# Daily Transactions

```{r}
#Computing daily transactions
ae_full_dates <- tibble(accepted_date = seq(min(ae_documentline$accepted_date), 
                                      max(ae_documentline$accepted_date), by = "day"))
                                      
daily_transaction <- ae_documentline |>
  group_by(accepted_date) |>
  summarise(
    daily_transaction_count = n_distinct(headerid), 
    daily_transaction = sum(as.numeric(rprop1), na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  right_join(ae_full_dates, by = "accepted_date")|>
  arrange(accepted_date)
```

```{r}
#Daily transactions over all time
daily_transaction |>
  ggplot(aes(x = accepted_date, y = daily_transaction)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "All Time Daily Transactions",
       x = "Date",
       y = "Total Daily Transaction (USD)")

#Number of daily transaction over all time
daily_transaction |>
  ggplot(aes(x = accepted_date, y = daily_transaction_count)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "All Time Daily Transaction Count",
       x = "Date",
       y = "Number of Daily Transactions")
```

```{r}
#Daily transactions over specific range of time
start_date <- 20180101
end_date <- 20181231

daily_transaction |>
  filter(accepted_date >= ymd(start_date) & accepted_date <= ymd(end_date))|>
  ggplot(aes(x = accepted_date, y = daily_transaction)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = paste0("Daily Transaction from ", ymd(start_date), " to ", ymd(end_date)),
       x = "Date",
       y = "Total Daily Transaction (USD)")

daily_transaction |>
  filter(accepted_date >= ymd(start_date) & accepted_date <= ymd(end_date))|>
  ggplot(aes(x = accepted_date, y = daily_transaction_count)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = paste0("Daily Transaction Count from ", ymd(start_date), " to ", ymd(end_date)),
       x = "Date",
       y = "Daily Transaction count")
```

# Natural Disasters

```{r}
#Transforming the disaster data
disaster <- events_GA |>
  clean_names()|>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(date = list(seq(ymd(`begin_date`), ymd(`end_date`), by = "day"))) |>
  unnest_longer(date)|>
  filter(disaster != "Drought" & disaster != "Wildfire")
```

# Natural Disasters and Transactions

```{r}
#Joining natural disaster and daily transaction data
disaster_on_transaction <- left_join(
  daily_transaction |>
    rename(date = accepted_date), 
  disaster |>
    select(date, disaster, unadjusted_cost), 
  by = "date"
) |>
  mutate(unadjusted_cost = as.numeric(unadjusted_cost))
```

```{r}
#Creating weekly data
weekly_disaster_on_transaction <- disaster_on_transaction |>
  group_by(date = floor_date(date,"week"))|>
  summarise(weekly_transaction_count = ifelse(all(is.na(daily_transaction_count)), NA, 
                                         sum(daily_transaction_count, na.rm = TRUE)),
            weekly_transaction = ifelse(all(is.na(daily_transaction)), NA, 
                                         sum(daily_transaction, na.rm = TRUE)),
            weekly_cost = first(na.omit(unadjusted_cost)),
            disaster = first(na.omit(disaster)),
            .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
#Plotting Natural Disaster and Weekly Transactions
start_date <- ymd("20200101")
end_date <- ymd("20201231")

weekly_disaster_on_transaction |>
  mutate(weekly_cost = if_else(is.na(disaster) & is.na(weekly_cost), 0, weekly_cost))|>
  filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = weekly_transaction, color = "Weekly Transaction ($)")) +  
  geom_line(aes(y = weekly_cost, color = "Weekly Natural Disaster Cost (million $)")) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Natural Disaster Cost and AE Transactions from ", start_date, " to ", end_date),
    x = "Date",
    y = "Value",
    color = "Legend") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```


```{r}
#Plotting Natural Disaster's effect on Weekly Transactions
weekly_disaster_on_transaction |>
  mutate(weekly_cost = if_else(is.na(disaster) & is.na(weekly_cost), 0, weekly_cost))|>
  ggplot(aes(x = weekly_cost, y = weekly_transaction, color = disaster))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "blue")+
  labs(title = "Natural Disaster's Effect on AE Transactions",
       y = "Weekly Transactions ($)",
       x = "Weekly Natural Disaster Cost (million $)",
       color = "Disaster")
```

#Plotting Natural Disaster's effect on Weekly Transaction Count
weekly_disaster_on_transaction |>
  mutate(weekly_cost = replace_na(weekly_cost, 0))|>
  ggplot(aes(x = weekly_cost, y = weekly_transaction_count, color = disaster))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "blue")+
  labs(title = "Effect of Natural Disaster on AE Food Transaction Count",
       y = "Weekly Transaction Count",
       x = "Weekly Natural Disaster Cost (million $)",
       color = "Disaster")

#Plotting Natural Disaster and Daily Transactions
disaster_on_transaction |>
  mutate(unadjusted_cost = replace_na(unadjusted_cost, 0))|>
  filter(date >= ymd("20200601") & date <= ymd("20201230"))|>
  ggplot(aes(x = date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = daily_transaction), color = "#1f77b4") +  
  geom_line(aes(y = unadjusted_cost),color = "#ff7f0e")+
  labs(title = "Daily Transactions and Cost of Disaster Over Time")


#Plotting Natural Disaster's effect on Daily Transactions
disaster_on_transaction |>
  mutate(unadjusted_cost = if_else(is.na(disaster) & is.na(unadjusted_cost), 0, 1))|>
  ggplot(aes(x = unadjusted_cost, y = daily_transaction, color = disaster))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue")
